hero.founded: Founded by Ayman Seif • 126 Namespaces • One Root Key • Sovereign Identity Infrastructure
hero.desc1: teos is the master root credential of the TEOS ecosystem. It serves as the foundation for sovereign country identities and next-generation digital ownership.
hero.desc2: We sell sovereign digital identities. We distribute sovereign identity keys that enable participation in the TEOS ecosystem.
hero.cta: Claim your sovereign identity. Own your name across 126 namespaces.

pricing.how1: .teos is the root key. A country name only unlocks if the wallet has saloma.teos, either in same purchase or already owned. Server enforces this.
pricing.how2: After .teos, buyer can register your name in 126 country namespaces. List in namespaces/all.json
pricing.ownership: Every name is a Metaplex Core asset on Solana, owned by buyer wallet, tradable from Phantom, Solflare, Backpack
